source: M3.1: work-types declare produces; artifact types show the reverse view generated. Keyed before the change was evaluated; drafted alongside it. R2 re-keyed after produces-01: it asked for the backlog record of the gap, which lives in docs/ and is unreachable from the product by design.

probes.question: Which unit of work produces a project's backlog entries, and where would you look to find out?
probes.key: W16 bank an idea and W20 reconcile a ledger produce AR5 backlog entries; the AR5 entry lists them in a generated Produced by section, built from each work-type's produces field.
probes.rubric: 2 for W16 and W20 with the generated section or the produces field. 1 for one work-type or the mechanism alone. 0 otherwise.

probes.question: Which work-type produces a board?
probes.key: None: no work-type produces an AR3 board - selecting the next moves has no work-type, and AR3's generated Produced by section is empty.
probes.rubric: 2 for none, from the empty Produced by section or the absence of any produces field naming AR3. 1 for none, hedged. 0 for naming a work-type.
